records.title: A combined intervention changes MLN Th17 proportions
records.statement: In germ-free mice, the BI + HMO group had a higher mesenteric-lymph-node Th17-cell proportion than the HMO-only group.
records.exposure: B. infantis ATCC 15697 plus 2′-FL, LNT and 3′-SL
records.comparator: Same HMO mixture without B. infantis
records.duration: 14 days; bacterial gavage on days 1, 4 and 9
records.dose: 5 mg/day of each HMO (15 mg/day total); 1 × 10^9 CFU per bacterial dosing day
records.endpoint: MLN Th17 cells as a percentage of CD4+ T cells
records.sourceLocation: PDF page 3: B. infantis shapes spleen and MLN immune cell composition; Figure 3; Figure 1 study design
records.evidenceSummary: The result concerns a group comparison in a combined-intervention mouse experiment.
records.limitation: 2′-FL was one of three HMOs. The comparison does not isolate a 2′-FL effect, establish a microbial mechanism, or show a clinical benefit in infants.
records.nextAction: Verify Figure 3 and statistical contrast with a domain reviewer; retain the mixture and comparator.
records.subject: mixture
records.mappingStatus: Candidate interpretation; not an equivalence axiom
records.supportLevel: Prior pilot extraction; expert validation pending
